spec.notes: Prebuilt AOT applications with one mutator/marker; exact full-scale CPython stdout checks precede measurement. Native uses GC_MIN32MiB; BDW defaults and initial32MiB are DISTINCT policies, not matched heap caps. Incremental/generational explicitly use documented page protection, not unavailable soft-dirty mode. Same 2048 MiB RLIMIT_AS, observed RSS. Five rotated measured rounds and one excluded warmup, CPU 3, no owned heavy concurrent work. In-memory JSON is a separate workload using exact static literal input and complete stdout. BDW stopped_world_ms is not total GC CPU or elapsed.
